note: Valid SpecTherm — each program PARSES (thermite-syntax) and the thermite-spec validator must ACCEPT it (no SpecError). Covers all 8 registered combinators in contract positions + a spec-fn call in a contract. Hand-derived from §4.2 + the corpus (R-CHAR-3); expected behavior is 'validates clean', never copied from validator output.

cases.name: sorted_in_req
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> u32 req sorted(xs) ens result == 0 fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: forall_in_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], n: u32) -> u32 req true ens forall_in(xs, |x| x != n) fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: exists_in_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], n: u32) -> u32 req true ens exists_in(xs, |x| x == n) fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: count_where_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> usize req true ens count_where(xs, |x| x == 0) <= xs.len() fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: permutation_of_in_req
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], ys: &[u32]) -> u32 req permutation_of(xs, ys) ens result == 0 fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: disjoint_in_req
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], ys: &[u32]) -> u32 req disjoint(xs, ys) ens result == 0 fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: forall_below_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], i: usize) -> u32 req true ens forall_below(xs, i, |x| x < 5) fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: forall_from_in_ens
cases.program: fn f(xs: &[u32], i: usize) -> u32 req true ens forall_from(xs, i, |x| x > 5) fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: spec_fn_call_in_ens
cases.program: spec fn sz(xs: &[u32]) -> usize dec xs.len() { xs.len() } fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> usize req true ens result == sz(xs) fx pure { 0 }

cases.name: named_spec_fn_in_closure
cases.program: spec fn is_small(x: u32) -> bool dec 0 { x < 10 } fn f(xs: &[u32]) -> u32 req true ens forall_in(xs, |x| is_small(x)) fx pure { 0 }
